name: Settings Float
description: Opens the Ambxst Settings window as a centred floating window sized to the screen it opens on (41% wide, 66% tall by default, never below its 900x650 design size, never above 92% of the screen) instead of tiling it. The window declares a fixed size until the compositor has placed it, which makes Hyprland, Niri and dwl-based compositors float it the moment it maps (Hyprland and Niri centre it too), so it never appears as a tile first. No window rule needed. Size and an on/off switch are in the mod's settings.
author: drpezzer
permissions: Declares a fixed window size for the Settings window until the compositor has placed it
